releases.name: Polishing patch
releases.body:
Mod settings now clearer, default colours are white,
Player markers now despawn when the player leaves,
Updated bot consistency.
releases.bodyZh:
MOD設定がより明確になった、デフォルトの色は白、
プレイヤーマーカーはプレイヤーが去った時に消える、
ボットの整合性を更新。

releases.name: Bug fixes
releases.body:

Other fixes I've forgotten about maybe.

releases.name: Messages
releases.body:
Create recorded messages for other players, even when you have left the game!
These messages will last for one week.
Players can appraise your message, increasing its lifespan by a week.
Have fun!

Bugfixes:
I can't even remember

releases.name: Custom skins
releases.body:
Custom skins are now a config option!
Skins currently available:
Protagonist,
Gabbro,
Chert,
Feldspar.
For custom skins the only colour option is clothesColour, which changes the entire model, due to varying meshes.

releases.name: Syncing fixes
releases.body:
Increased the area around the player to be syncing by 100x.
Players away from all astral bodies will now be indicated as unstable.
Fixed unreliable sector system.

releases.name: General Improvements
releases.body:
Smarter player colour hash generation using analogous colours.
Each mesh on the player (Head, Arms, Clothes Jetpack) can be assigned a different colour.
You can now lock onto other player's ships, allowing for velocity alignment and autopilot.
Fixed chat !1 bug.
